hero.headline: Build a writing habit, *five minutes* at a time.
hero.sub: A writing habit for people who write in stolen minutes, not for a living.

screenplay.headline: Write a script that *looks* like a script.
screenplay.sub: Scene headings, cues and dialogue format themselves as you type, and Tab moves you on to the next line. Screenplay mode is in beta.

reminders.headline: Get a reminder that knows *where you left off.*
reminders.sub: Pick your days. Each reminder quotes the last lines you wrote and nudges you back into the scene.

commute.headline: Make your commute a *writing session.*
commute.sub: Start a 15 minute sprint, pick up on your last sentence, and keep going with no signal. Everything saves.

suggest.headline: Let Ciciro *suggest.* You decide.
suggest.sub: Edits arrive as tracked changes. Swap a limp metaphor for one you can see, or reject it and keep yours.

exercise.headline: Learn to *enjoy* writing.
exercise.sub: Short guided exercises turn a blank page into ten minutes you look forward to. A weekly review tells you what to write next.

bible.headline: Keep every detail *straight.*
bible.sub: Characters, places and canon sit beside your chapters, so you never scroll back to check what color her eyes were.

themes.headline: Make it *yours.*
themes.sub: From bright paper to a candle-lit night, there is a page to suit the hour you write in.

scan.headline: Scan your *handwritten notes* into your story bible.
scan.sub: Photograph a notebook page, check what Ciciro read, then choose where it goes: your story bible or your outline cards.

feature.headline: Build a writing habit, *five minutes* at a time.
feature.kicker: For people who write around a job, a family, a life
